note: The seventh ḥizb, recited on Sunday — a continuation of the great enumerative ṣalawāt begun the day before, invoking blessings as many times as every created thing, followed by the well-known Ibrāhīmī salawāt, a chain of salutations upon the angels and prophets, and an extended litany in praise of the Prophet ﷺ. The Book Version pagination is still to be set.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ سَبَّحَكَ وَقَدَّسَكَ، وَسَجَدَ لَكَ وَعَظَّمَكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada man sabbaḥaka wa qaddasaka, wa sajada laka wa ʿaẓẓamaka, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as those who glorify You, those who worship You, those who prostrate to You, and those who magnify You, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ خَلَقْتَهُمْ فِيهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada kulli sanatin khalaqtahum fīhā, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as the years in which You created them (those who glorify You, mentioned above), from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadadas saḥābil jāriyah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every drifting cloud.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadadar riyāḥidh dhāriyati, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every scattering wind, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ عَلَيْهِ، وَحَرَّكَتْهُ مِنَ الْأَغْصَانِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ، وَأَوْرَاقِ الثِّمَارِ وَالْأَزْهَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ عَلٰى قَرَارِ أَرْضِكَ وَمَا بَيْنَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‖ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada mā habbatir riyāḥu ʿalayhi, wa ḥarrakathu minal aghṣāni wal ashjāri, wa awrāqith thimāri wal azhāri, wa ʿadada mā khalaqta ʿalā qarāri arḍika wa mā bayna samāwātika, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as the wind has blown upon every branch and tree, the leaves of the fruit and flowers, and stirred them, and as many times as all You have created upon the surface of Your earth and between Your heavens, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ بِحَارِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada amwāji biḥārika, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as the number of the waves of Your seas, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالْحَصَى وَكُلِّ حَجَرٍ وَمَدَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، سَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadadar ramli wal ḥaṣā wa kulli ḥajarin wa madarin khalaqtahu fī mashāriqil arḍi wa maghāribihā, sahlihā wa jibālihā wa awdiyatihā, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every grain of sand, every pebble, every stone and every clod of earth You have created in the East and West of the earth, on its lowlands, its mountains and its valleys, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ نَبَاتِ الْأَرْضِ فِي قِبْلَتِهَا وَجَوْفِهَا، وَشَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا، وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا، مِنْ شَجَرٍ وَثَمَرٍ وَأَوْرَاقٍ وَزَرْعٍ وَجَمِيعِ مَا أَخْرَجَتْ، وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا مِنْ نَبَاتِهَا وَبَرَكَاتِهَا مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada nabātil arḍi fī qiblatihā wa jawfihā, wa sharqihā wa gharbihā, wa sahlihā wa jibālihā, min shajarin wa thamarin wa awrāqin wa zarʿin wa jamīʿi mā akhrajat, wa mā yakhruju minhā min nabātihā wa barakātihā, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every plant of the earth in its south and its north, its east and its west, its lowlands and its mountains — every tree, fruit, leaf and crop, and all it has brought forth and all it will yet bring forth of its growth and its blessings, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْهُمْ ‖ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada mā khalaqta minal insi wal jinni wash shayāṭīni, wa mā anta khāliquhu minhum ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every human being, jinn, and devil You have created, and all You will yet create of them until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَوُجُوهِهِمْ وَعَلٰى رُؤُوسِهِمْ، مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada kulli shaʿratin fī abdānihim wa wujūhihim wa ʿalā ruʾūsihim, mundhu khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every hair on their bodies, their faces and their heads, since the time You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَأَلْحَاظِهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada anfāsihim wa alfāẓihim wa alḥāẓihim, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every one of their breaths, every one of their words, and every one of their glances, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَخَفَقَانِ الْإِنْسِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada ṭayarānil jinni wa khafaqānil insi, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every flight of a jinn and every heartbeat of a human being, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا عَلٰى أَرْضِكَ صَغِيرَةً وَكَبِيرَةً، فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، مِمَّا عُلِمَ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada kulli bahīmatin khalaqtahā ʿalā arḍika ṣaghīratan wa kabīratan, fī mashāriqil arḍi wa maghāribihā, mimmā ʿulima wa mimmā lā yaʿlamu ʿilmahu illā anta, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every creature, small and great, that You have created upon Your earth in the East and West, those that are known and those known to none but You, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ ‖ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada man ṣallā ʿalayhi, wa ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa ʿadada man yuṣallī ʿalayhi ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as those who have asked blessings upon him, as many times as those who have not, and as many times as those who will ask blessings upon him until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ الْأَحْيَاءِ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ حِيتَانٍ وَطَيْرٍ وَنَمْلٍ وَنَحْلٍ وَحَشَرَاتٍ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadadal aḥyāʾi wal amwāti, wa ʿadada mā khalaqta min ḥītānin wa ṭayrin wa namlin wa naḥlin wa ḥasharāt
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many times as every soul, living and dead, and every fish, bird, ant, bee and insect You have created.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ فِي اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi fil layli idhā yaghshā wan nahāri idhā tajallā
verses.en: And bless him and his family in every darkening night and every brightening day.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi fil ākhirati wal ūlā
verses.en: And bless him and his family in the Last Life and the First.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ مُنْذُ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا، إِلَى أَنْ صَارَ كَهْلًا مَهْدِيًّا، فَقَبَضْتَهُ إِلَيْكَ عَدْلًا مَّرْضِيًّا، لِتَبْعَثَهُ شَفِيعًا
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi mundhu kāna fil mahdi ṣabiyyan ilā an ṣāra kahlan mahdiyyan, fa qabaḍtahu ilayka ʿadlan marḍiyyan, li tabʿathahu shafīʿan
verses.en: And bless him and his family from the time he was a child in the cradle until he became a mature man, rightly guided, when You took him to Yourself, just and well-pleasing, so that You might send him forth as an intercessor.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ ۞ وَأَنْ تُعْطِيَهُ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَالْحَوْضَ الْمَوْرُودَ، وَالْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ، وَالْعِزَّ الْمَمْدُودَ ۞ وَأَنْ تُعَظِّمَ ‖ بُرْهَانَهُ ۞ وَأَنْ تُشَرِّفَ بُنْيَانَهُ ۞ وَأَنْ تَرْفَعَ مَكَانَهُ ۞ وَأَنْ تَسْتَعْمِلَنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا بِسُنَّتِهِ ۞ وَأَنْ تُمِيتَنَا عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ
verses.tr: Wa an tuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada khalqika wa riḍāʾa nafsika wa zinata ʿarshika wa midāda kalimātika, wa an tuʿṭiyahul wasīlata wal faḍīlata, wad darajatar rafīʿata, wal ḥawḍal mawrūd, wal maqāmal maḥmūd, wal ʿizzal mamdūd, wa an tuʿaẓẓima burhānahu, wa an tusharrifa bunyānahu, wa an tarfaʿa makānahu, wa an tastaʿmilanā yā mawlānā bi sunnatihi, wa an tumītanā ʿalā millatihi
verses.en: And bless him and his family as many as Your creation, to the extent of Your good pleasure, the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your Words; and grant him the Wasīla and the Faḍīla, the Lofty Rank, the Oft-Visited Pool, the Praiseworthy Station, and Everlasting Honor; magnify his proof, ennoble his standing, and raise his station; and cause us, O our Master, to live by his Sunnah and to die following his religion.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ تَحْشُرَنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ ۞ وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ ۞ وَأَنْ تُورِدَنَا حَوْضَهُ ۞ وَأَنْ تَسْقِيَنَا بِكَأْسِهِ ۞ وَأَنْ تَنْفَعَنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ ۞ وَأَنْ تَتُوبَ عَلَيْنَا ۞ وَأَنْ تُعَافِيَنَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَاءِ وَالْفِتَنِ، مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ ۞ وَأَنْ تَرْحَمَنَا، وَأَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنَّا وَتَغْفِرَ لَنَا، وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ، الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ ۞ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ وَهُوَ حَسْبِي وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ ۞ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Wa an taḥshuranā fī zumratihi, wa taḥta liwāʾihi, wa an tajʿalanā min rufaqāʾihi, wa an tūridanā ḥawḍahu, wa an tasqiyanā bikaʾsihi, wa an tanfaʿanā bimaḥabbatihi, wa an tatūba ʿalaynā, wa an tuʿāfiyanā min jamīʿil balāʾi wal balwāʾi wal fitani, mā ẓahara minhā wa mā baṭana, wa an tarḥamanā, wa an taʿfuwa ʿannā wa taghfira lanā, wa li jamīʿil muʾminīna wal muʾmināti, wal muslimīna wal muslimāti, al aḥyāʾi minhum wal amwāti, wal ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil ʿālamīn, wa huwa ḥasbī wa niʿmal wakīl, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhil ʿaliyyil ʿaẓīm
verses.en: And resurrect us in his company, beneath his banner; make us among his companions; bring us to his Pool and give us to drink from his cup; let us benefit from love of him; accept our repentance; and shelter us from every trial and tribulation, outward and hidden; have mercy on us, pardon us, and forgive us, together with all believing men and women and all Muslim men and women, the living and the dead among them. Praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds; He is sufficient for me, and the best of Guardians; there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Almighty.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا سَجَعَتِ الْحَمَائِمُ، وَحَمَتِ الْحَوَائِمُ، وَسَرَحَتِ الْبَهَائِمُ، وَنَفَعَتِ التَّمَائِمُ، ‖ وَشُدَّتِ الْعَمَائِمُ، وَنَمَتِ التَّوَائِمُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā sajaʿatil ḥamāʾimu, wa ḥamatil ḥawāʾimu, wa saraḥatil bahāʾimu, wa nafaʿatit tamāʾimu, wa shuddatil ʿamāʾimu, wa namatin tawāʾim
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for as long as doves coo, circling beasts linger at the waterholes, cattle graze the pasture, amulets bring benefit, turbans are wound, and twins grow in number.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا أَبْلَجَ الْإِصْبَاحُ، وَهَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ، وَدَبَّتِ الْأَشْبَاحُ، وَتَعَاقَبَ الْغُدُوُّ وَالرَّوَاحُ، وَتُقُلِّدَتِ الصِّفَاحُ، وَاعْتُقِلَتِ الرِّمَاحُ، وَصَحَّتِ الْأَجْسَادُ وَالْأَرْوَاحُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā ablajal iṣbāḥu, wa habbatir riyāḥu, wa dabbatil ashbāḥu, wa taʿāqabal ghuduwwu war rawāḥu, wa tuqullidatiṣ ṣifāḥu, wa uʿtuqilatir rimāḥu, wa ṣaḥḥatil ajsādu wal arwāḥ
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for as long as dawn breaks, winds blow, shadows creep, morning and evening alternate, swords are girded on, spears are grasped, and bodies and souls are sound.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا دَارَتِ الْأَفْلَاكُ، وَدَجَتِ الْأَحْلَاكُ، وَسَبَّحَتِ الْأَمْلَاكُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā dāratil aflāku, wa dajatil aḥlāku, wa sabbaḥatil amlāk
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for as long as the celestial spheres revolve, darkness falls, and the angels glorify.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma fil ʿālamīna innaka ḥamīdun majīd
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham, among all created beings; for You are indeed the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَّا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ، وَمَا صُلِّيَتِ الْخَمْسُ، وَمَا تَأَلَّقَ بَرْقٌ، وَتَدَفَّقَ وَدْقٌ، وَمَا سَبَّحَ رَعْدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā ṭalaʿatish shamsu, wa mā ṣulliyatil khamsu, wa mā taʾallaqa barqun, wa tadaffaqa wadqun, wa mā sabbaḥa raʿdun
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for as long as the sun rises, the five daily prayers are performed, lightning flashes, rain pours down, and thunder resounds in praise.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ ‖ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin milʾas samāwāti wal arḍi wa milʾa mā baynahumā, wa milʾa mā shiʾta min shayʾin baʿdu
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad to the fullness of the heavens and the earth, to the fullness of whatever lies between them, and to the fullness of whatever else You may will.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ كَمَا قَامَ بِأَعْبَاءِ الرِّسَالَةِ، وَاسْتَنْقَذَ الْخَلْقَ مِنَ الْجَهَالَةِ، وَجَاهَدَ أَهْلَ الْكُفْرِ وَالضَّلَالَةِ، وَدَعَا إِلَى تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَقَاسَى الشَّدَائِدَ فِي إِرْشَادِ عَبِيدِكَ، فَأَعْطِهِ اللّٰهُمَّ سُؤْلَهُ، وَبَلِّغْهُ مَأْمُولَهُ، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَّهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma kamā qāma bi aʿbāʾir risālati, wastanqadhal khalqa minal jahālati, wa jāhada ahlal kufri waḍ ḍalālati, wa daʿā ilā tawḥīdika, wa qāsāsh shadāʾida fī irshādi ʿabīdika, fa aʿṭihi Allāhumma suʾlahu, wa balligh-hu maʾmūlahu, wa ātihil wasīlata wal faḍīlata wad darajatar rafīʿata, wabʿathhul maqāmal maḥmūda alladhī waʿadtahu, innaka lā tukhliful mīʿād
verses.en: O Allah, just as he bore the burden of the Message, delivered creation from ignorance, strove against the people of unbelief and error, called to Your Oneness, and endured hardship in guiding Your servants — grant him, O Allah, his request, deliver to him his hope, and give him the Wasīla, the Faḍīla, and the Lofty Rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him; truly You do not break Your promise.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُتَّبِعِينَ لِشَرِيعَتِهِ، وَالْمُتَّصِفِينَ بِمَحَبَّتِهِ، الْمُهْتَدِينَ بِهَدْيِهِ وَسِيرَتِهِ ۞ وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰى سُنَّتِهِ ۞ وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا فَضْلَ شَفَاعَتِهِ ۞ وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي أَتْبَاعِهِ الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِينَ ۞ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ السَّابِقِينَ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ ۞ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wajʿalnā minal muttabiʿīna li sharīʿatihi, wal muttaṣifīna bi maḥabbatihi, al muhtadīna bi hadyihi wa sīratihi, wa tawaffanā ʿalā sunnatihi, wa lā taḥrimnā faḍla shafāʿatihi, waḥshurnā fī atbāʿihil ghurril muḥajjalīna, wa ashyāʿihis sābiqīna, wa aṣḥābil yamīni, yā arḥamar rāḥimīn
verses.en: O Allah, make us among the followers of his law, those characterized by love for him, those guided by his guidance and his way of life; cause us to die upon his Sunnah; do not deprive us of the merit of his intercession; and resurrect us among his followers, those with bright faces and limbs, his foremost companions, and the Companions of the Right Hand — O Most Merciful of the merciful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَالْمُقَرَّبِينَ ۞ وَعَلٰى أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَعَلٰى أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِمْ ‖ مِنَ الْمَرْحُومِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā malāʾikatika wal muqarrabīna, wa ʿalā anbiyāʾika wal mursalīna, wa ʿalā ahli ṭāʿatika ajmaʿīna, wajʿalnā biṣ ṣalāti ʿalayhim minal marḥūmīn
verses.en: O Allah, bless Your angels and those brought near, and Your Prophets and Messengers, and all the people obedient to You; and make us, through our asking blessings upon them, among those shown mercy.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِنِ الْمَبْعُوثِ مِنْ تِهَامَةَ، وَالْآمِرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالِاسْتِقَامَةِ، وَالشَّفِيعِ لِأَهْلِ الذُّنُوبِ فِي عَرَصَاتِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadinil mabʿūthi min Tihāmata, wal āmiri bil maʿrūfi wal istiqāmati, wash shafīʿi li ahlidh dhunūbi fī ʿaraṣātil qiyāmah
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the one sent forth from Tihāmah, the Commander of what is right and of steadfastness, the Intercessor for the people of sin on the plains of the Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَبْلِغْ عَنَّا نَبِيَّنَا وَشَفِيعَنَا وَحَبِيبَنَا أَفْضَلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الْكَرِيمَ، وَآتِهِ الْفَضِيلَةَ وَالْوَسِيلَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَّهُ فِي الْمَوْقِفِ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma abligh ʿannā nabiyyanā wa shafīʿanā wa ḥabībanā afḍalaṣ ṣalāti wat taslīmi, wabʿathhul maqāmal maḥmūdal karīma, wa ātihil faḍīlata wal wasīlata, wad darajatar rafīʿatal latī waʿadtahu fil mawqifil ʿaẓīm
verses.en: O Allah, convey from us to our Prophet, our Intercessor, and our Beloved the finest of blessings and peace, and raise him to the Praised and Noble Station; grant him the Faḍīla and the Wasīla, and the Lofty Rank which You promised him on the Mighty Standing.

verses.ar: وَصَلِّ اللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مُّتَّصِلَةً تَتَوَالَى وَتَدُومُ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalli Allāhumma ʿalayhi ṣalātan dāʾimatan muttaṣilatan tatawālā wa tadūm
verses.en: And bless him, O Allah, with blessings continual, unbroken, ever-recurring and everlasting.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ مَا لَاحَ بَارِقٌ، وَذَرَّ شَارِقٌ، وَوَقَبَ غَاسِقٌ، وَانْهَمَرَ وَادِقٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi mā lāḥa bāriqun, wa dharra shāriqun, wa waqaba ghāsiqun, wa anhamara wādiqun
verses.en: O Allah, bless him and his family for as long as lightning gleams, dawn breaks, night falls, and rain pours down.

verses.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ مِلْءَ اللَّوْحِ وَالْفَضَاءِ، وَمِثْلَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، وَعَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْحَصَى ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً لَا تُعَدُّ وَلَا تُحْصَى
verses.tr: Wa ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi milʾal lawḥi wal faḍāʾi, wa mithla nujūmis samāʾi, wa ʿadadal qaṭri wal ḥaṣā, wa ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan lā tuʿaddu wa lā tuḥṣā
verses.en: And bless him and his family to the fullness of the Tablet and of space, and like the number of the stars of the sky and the drops of rain and the grains of sand; and bless him and his family with blessings beyond count and beyond number.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَبْلَغَ رِضَاكَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَمُنْتَهَى رَحْمَتِكَ ‖
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhi zinata ʿarshika, wa mablagha riḍāka, wa midāda kalimātika, wa muntahā raḥmatika
verses.en: O Allah, bless him to the weight of Your Throne, the extent of Your good pleasure, the ink of Your Words, and the utmost of Your Mercy.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi, wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamā ṣallayta wa bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd
verses.en: O Allah, bless him and his family, his wives and his descendants, and sanctify him and his family, his wives and his descendants, just as You blessed and sanctified our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham; for You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.

verses.ar: وَجَازِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ بِمِنْهَاجِ شَرِيعَتِهِ، وَاهْدِنَا بِهَدْيِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا يَوْمَ الْفَزَعِ الْأَكْبَرِ مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَأَمِتْنَا عَلٰى حُبِّهِ وَحُبِّ آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ
verses.tr: Wa jāzihi ʿannā afḍala mā jāzayta nabiyyan ʿan ummatihi, wajʿalnā minal muhtadīna bi minhāji sharīʿatihi, wahdinā bi hadyihi, wa tawaffanā ʿalā millatihi, waḥshurnā yawmal fazaʿil akbari minal āminīna fī zumratihi, wa amitnā ʿalā ḥubbihi wa ḥubbi ālihi wa aṣḥābihi wa dhurriyyatihi
verses.en: And reward him on our behalf better than You have rewarded any Prophet on behalf of his nation; make us among those guided by the path of his law; guide us by his guidance; cause us to die upon his religion; and resurrect us on the Day of the Greatest Terror among those secure in his company; and let us die loving him, loving his family, his Companions, and his descendants.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، وَأَكْرَمِ أَصْفِيَائِكَ، وَإِمَامِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَخَاتَمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، وَحَبِيبِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَشَهِيدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَشَفِيعِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ، وَسَيِّدِ وُلْدِ آدَمَ أَجْمَعِينَ، الْمَرْفُوعِ الذِّكْرِ فِي الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ، الْبَشِيرِ النَّذِيرِ، السِّرَاجِ الْمُنِيرِ، الصَّادِقِ الْأَمِينِ، الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ، الرَّؤُوفِ الرَّحِيمِ، الْهَادِي إِلَى ‖ الصِّرَاطِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ، الَّذِي آتَيْتَهُ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ ۞ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَهَادِي الْأُمَّةِ، أَوَّلِ مَنْ تَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الْأَرْضُ وَيَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ، الْمُؤَيَّدِ بِسَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ وَسَيِّدِنَا مِيكَائِيلَ، الْمُبَشَّرِ بِهِ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، الْمُصْطَفَى الْمُجْتَبَى، الْمُنْتَخَبِ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin afḍali anbiyāʾika, wa akrami aṣfiyāʾika, wa imāmi awliyāʾika, wa khātami anbiyāʾika, wa ḥabībi rabbil ʿālamīna, wa shahīdil mursalīna, wa shafīʿil mudhnibīna, wa sayyidi wuldi Ādama ajmaʿīna, al marfūʿidh dhikri fil malāʾikatil muqarrabīna, al bashīrin nadhīri, as sirājil munīri, aṣ ṣādiqil amīni, al ḥaqqil mubīni, ar raʾūfir raḥīmi, al hādī ilaṣ ṣirāṭil mustaqīmi, alladhī ātaytahu sabʿan minal mathānī wal qurʾānal ʿaẓīma, nabiyyir raḥmati, wa hādil ummati, awwali man tanshaqqu ʿanhul arḍu wa yadkhulul jannata, al muʾayyadi bi sayyidinā Jibrīla wa sayyidinā Mīkāʾīla, al mubashshari bihi fit tawrāti wal injīli, al muṣṭafal mujtabā, al muntakhabi abil Qāsimi, sayyidinā Muḥammadin ibni ʿAbdillāhi ibni ʿAbdil Muṭṭalibi ibni Hāshim
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the finest of Your Prophets, the noblest of Your chosen ones, the leader of Your saints, the seal of Your Prophets, the beloved of the Lord of the Worlds, the witness over the Messengers, the intercessor for sinners, the master of all the children of Adam, he whose renown is exalted among the angels brought near, the bearer of good tidings and the warner, the shining lamp, the truthful, the trustworthy, the manifest truth, the compassionate, the merciful, the guide to the straight path, to whom You gave the seven oft-repeated verses and the Mighty Qur'an, the Prophet of Mercy and the Guide of the Nation, the first for whom the earth will split open and who will enter the Garden, the one supported by our master Gabriel and our master Michael, the one foretold in the Torah and the Gospel, the Chosen, the Selected, the Elect, Abū al-Qāsim, our master Muhammad, son of Abdullah, son of Abd al-Muttalib, son of Hashim.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَالْمُقَرَّبِينَ، الَّذِينَ ﴿ يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ ﴾، ﴿ وَلَا يَعْصُونَ اللّٰهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ﴾
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā malāʾikatika wal muqarrabīna, alladhīna yusabbiḥūnal layla wan nahāra lā yafturūna, wa lā yaʿṣūna Allāha mā amarahum wa yafʿalūna mā yuʾmarūn
verses.en: O Allah, bless Your angels and those brought near, who glorify You night and day without flagging, and who do not disobey Allah in what He commands them, and who do as they are commanded.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَكَمَا اصْطَفَيْتَهُمْ سُفَرَاءَ إِلَى رُسُلِكَ، وَأُمَنَاءَ عَلٰى وَحْيِكَ، وَشُهَدَاءَ عَلٰى خَلْقِكَ، وَخَرَقْتَ لَهُمْ كُنُفَ حُجُبِكَ، وَأَطْلَعْتَهُمْ عَلٰى مَكْنُونِ غَيْبِكَ، وَاخْتَرْتَ مِنْهُمْ خَزَنَةً لِّجَنَّتِكَ، وَحَمَلَةً لِعَرْشِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ مِنْ أَكْثَرِ جُنُودِكَ، وَفَضَّلْتَهُمْ عَلٰى ‖ الْوَرَى، وَأَسْكَنْتَهُمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى، وَنَزَّهْتَهُمْ عَنِ الْمَعَاصِي وَالدَّنَاءَاتِ، وَقَدَّسْتَهُمْ عَنِ النَّقَائِصِ وَالْآفَاتِ ۞ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ بِهَا فَضْلًا، وَتَجْعَلُنَا لِاسْتِغْفَارِهِمْ بِهَا أَهْلًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa kamāṣṭafaytahum sufarāʾa ilā rusulika, wa umanāʾa ʿalā waḥyika, wa shuhadāʾa ʿalā khalqika, wa kharaqta lahum kunufa ḥujubika, wa aṭlaʿtahum ʿalā maknūni ghaybika, wakhtarta minhum khazanatan li jannatika, wa ḥamalatan li ʿarshika, wa jaʿaltahum min akthari junūdika, wa faḍḍaltahum ʿalal warā, wa askantahumus samāwātil ʿulā, wa nazzahtahum ʿanil maʿāṣī wad danāʾāti, wa qaddastahum ʿanin naqāʾiṣi wal āfāti, fa ṣalli ʿalayhim ṣalātan dāʾimatan tazīduhum bihā faḍlan, wa tajʿalunā li istighfārihim bihā ahlā
verses.en: O Allah, just as You chose them as envoys to Your Messengers, trustees over Your Revelation, and witnesses over Your creation; opened for them the folds of Your veils, and let them look upon the hidden things of Your Unseen; chose from among them keepers of Your Garden and bearers of Your Throne; made them the most numerous of Your hosts; favored them above [ordinary] creation; settled them in the highest heavens; kept them free from disobedience and baseness; and sanctified them from every fault and defect — so bless them with everlasting blessings that increase their honor, and make us worthy, through this, of their asking forgiveness for us.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ الَّذِينَ شَرَحْتَ صُدُورَهُمْ، وَأَوْدَعْتَهُمْ حِكْمَتَكَ، وَطَوَّقْتَهُمْ نُبُوَّتَكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُتُبَكَ، وَهَدَيْتَ بِهِمْ خَلْقَكَ، وَدَعَوْا إِلَى تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَشَوَّقُوا إِلَى وَعْدِكَ، وَخَوَّفُوا مِنْ وَعِيدِكَ، وَأَرْشَدُوا إِلَى سَبِيلِكَ، وَقَامُوا بِحُجَّتِكَ وَدَلِيلِكَ ۞ وَسَلِّمِ اللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيْهِمْ تَسْلِيمًا ۞ وَهَبْ لَنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā jamīʿi anbiyāʾika wa rusulikal ladhīna sharaḥta ṣudūrahum, wa awdaʿtahum ḥikmataka, wa ṭawwaqtahum nubuwwataka, wa anzalta ʿalayhim kutubaka, wa hadayta bihim khalqaka, wa daʿaw ilā tawḥīdika, wa shawwaqū ilā waʿdika, wa khawwafū min waʿīdika, wa arshadū ilā sabīlika, wa qāmū bi ḥujjatika wa dalīlika, wa sallimi Allāhumma ʿalayhim taslīmā, wa hab lanā biṣ ṣalāti ʿalayhim ajran ʿaẓīmā
verses.en: O Allah, bless all of Your Prophets and Messengers, whose hearts You have opened, to whom You entrusted Your Wisdom, whom You crowned with Your Prophethood, upon whom You sent down Your Books, and by whom You guided Your creation; who called to Your Oneness, gave glad tidings of Your Promise, warned of Your Threat, guided to Your Path, and upheld Your Proof and Your Evidence. Grant them abundant peace, O Allah, and through this asking of blessings upon them, grant us a mighty reward.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مَقْبُولَةً تُؤَدِّي بِهَا عَنَّا حَقَّهُ الْعَظِيمَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan dāʾimatan maqbūlatan tuʾaddī bihā ʿannā ḥaqqahul ʿaẓīm
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad with blessings everlasting and accepted, through which we discharge his tremendous right over us.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَاحِبِ الْحُسْنِ وَالْجَمَالِ، ‖ وَالْبَهْجَةِ وَالْكَمَالِ، وَالْبَهَاءِ وَالنُّورِ، وَالْوِلْدَانِ وَالْحُورِ، وَالْغُرَفِ وَالْقُصُورِ، وَاللِّسَانِ الشَّكُورِ، وَالْقَلْبِ الْمَشْكُورِ، وَالْعَلَمِ الْمَشْهُورِ، وَالْجَيْشِ الْمَنْصُورِ، وَالْبَنِينَ وَالْبَنَاتِ، وَالْأَزْوَاجِ الطَّاهِرَاتِ، وَالْعُلُوِّ عَلٰى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَالزَّمْزَمِ وَالْمَقَامِ، وَالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ، وَاجْتِنَابِ الْآثَامِ، وَتَرْبِيَةِ الْأَيْتَامِ، وَالْحَجِّ وَتِلَاوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَتَسْبِيحِ الرَّحْمٰنِ، وَصِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ، وَاللِّوَاءِ الْمَعْقُودِ، وَالْكَرَمِ وَالْجُودِ، وَالْوَفَاءِ بِالْعُهُودِ، صَاحِبِ الرَّغْبَةِ وَالتَّرْغِيبِ، وَالْبَغْلَةِ وَالنَّجِيبِ، وَالْحَوْضِ وَالْقَضِيبِ، النَّبِيِّ الْأَوَّابِ، النَّاطِقِ بِالصَّوَابِ، الْمَنْعُوتِ فِي الْكِتَابِ، النَّبِيِّ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ، النَّبِيِّ كَنْزِ اللّٰهِ، النَّبِيِّ حُجَّةِ اللّٰهِ، النَّبِيِّ مَنْ أَطَاعَهُ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللّٰهَ وَمَنْ عَصَاهُ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللّٰهَ، النَّبِيِّ الْعَرَبِيِّ، الْقُرَشِيِّ الزَّمْزَمِيِّ، الْمَكِّيِّ التِّهَامِيِّ، ‖ صَاحِبِ الْوَجْهِ الْجَمِيلِ، وَالطَّرْفِ الْكَحِيلِ، وَالْخَدِّ الْأَسِيلِ، وَالْكَوْثَرِ وَالسَّلْسَبِيلِ ۞ قَاهِرِ الْمُضَادِّينَ، مُبِيدِ الْكَافِرِينَ، وَقَاتِلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ۞ قَائِدِ الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِينَ إِلَى جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ، وَجِوَارِ الْكَرِيمِ ۞ صَاحِبِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَشَفِيعِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ، وَغَايَةِ الْغَمَامِ، وَمِصْبَاحِ الظَّلَامِ، وَقَمَرِ التَّمَامِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣāḥibil ḥusni wal jamāli, wal bahjati wal kamāli, wal bahāʾi wan nūri, wal wildāni wal ḥūri, wal ghurafi wal quṣūri, wal lisānish shakūri, wal qalbil mashkūri, wal ʿalamil mashhūri, wal jayshil manṣūri, wal banīna wal banāti, wal azwājiṭ ṭāhirāti, wal ʿuluwwi ʿalad darajāti, waz zamzami wal maqāmi, wal mashʿaril ḥarāmi, wajtinābil āthāmi, wa tarbiyatil aytāmi, wal ḥajji wa tilāwatil qurʾāni, wa tasbīḥir raḥmāni, wa ṣiyāmi Ramaḍāna, wal liwāʾil maʿqūdi, wal karami wal jūdi, wal wafāʾi bil ʿuhūdi, ṣāḥibir raghbati wat targhībi, wal baghlati wan najībi, wal ḥawḍi wal qaḍībi, an nabiyyil awwābi, an nāṭiqi biṣ ṣawābi, al manʿūti fil kitābi, an nabiyyi ʿAbdillāhi, an nabiyyi kanzi Llāhi, an nabiyyi ḥujjati Llāhi, an nabiyyi man aṭāʿahu faqad aṭāʿa Llāha wa man ʿaṣāhu faqad ʿaṣā Llāh, an nabiyyil ʿarabiyyi, al qurashiyyiz zamzamiyyi, al makkiyyit tihāmiyyi, ṣāḥibil wajhil jamīli, waṭ ṭarfil kaḥīli, wal khaddil asīli, wal kawthari was salsabīli, qāhiril muḍāddīna, mubīdil kāfirīna, wa qātilil mushrikīna, qāʾidil ghurril muḥajjalīna ilā jannātin naʿīmi, wa jiwāril karīmi, ṣāḥibi sayyidinā Jibrīla ʿalayhis salām, wa rasūli rabbil ʿālamīna, wa shafīʿil mudhnibīna, wa ghāyatil ghamāmi, wa miṣbāḥiẓ ẓalāmi, wa qamarit tamām
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, possessor of beauty and comeliness, of splendor and perfection, of radiance and light, of youthful attendants and maidens of Paradise, of chambers and palaces, of a grateful tongue and a thankful heart, of renowned standing and the victorious army, of sons and daughters, of pure wives, of the loftiest of ranks, of Zamzam and the Station of Abraham, of the Sacred Site, of avoiding sin, of raising orphans, of the Hajj and the recitation of the Qur'an, of glorifying the All-Merciful, of fasting Ramadan, of the bound banner, of nobility and generosity, of keeping covenants; possessor of longing for Allah and of kindling it in others, of the noble mount, of the Pool and the staff; the returning Prophet, the speaker of truth, the one described in the Scriptures; the Prophet, servant of Allah; the Prophet, treasure of Allah; the Prophet, proof of Allah; the Prophet whom to obey is to obey Allah, and whom to disobey is to disobey Allah; the Arab Prophet, of Quraysh, of Zamzam, of Mecca, of Tihamah; possessor of the handsome face, the kohled eyes, the smooth cheek, and the springs of Kawthar and Salsabil; subduer of adversaries, destroyer of unbelievers, slayer of polytheists, leader of those with bright faces and limbs to the Gardens of Bliss and the company of the Generous; companion of our master Gabriel, peace be upon him; Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, intercessor for sinners, farthest reach of the clouds, lamp of the darkness, and full moon.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ مِنْ أَطْهَرِ جِبِلَّةٍ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً عَلٰى الْأَبَدِ غَيْرَ مُضْمَحِلَّةٍ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً يَتَجَدَّدُ بِهَا حُبُورُهُ، وَيُشَرَّفُ بِهَا فِي الْمِيعَادِ بَعْثُهُ وَنُشُورُهُ ۞ فَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الْأَنْجُمِ الطَّوَالِعِ ۞ صَلَاةً تَجُودُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْوَدَ الْغُيُوثِ الْهَوَامِعِ، أَرْسَلَهُ مِنْ أَرْجَحِ الْعَرَبِ مِيزَانًا، وَأَوْضَحِهَا بَيَانًا، وَأَفْصَحِهَا لِسَانًا، وَأَشْمَخِهَا إِيمَانًا، ‖ وَأَعْلَاهَا مَقَامًا، وَأَحْلَاهَا كَلَامًا، وَأَوْفَاهَا ذِمَامًا، وَأَصْفَاهَا رَغَامًا ۞ فَأَوْضَحَ الطَّرِيقَةَ، وَنَصَحَ الْخَلِيقَةَ، وَشَهَّرَ الْإِسْلَامَ، وَكَسَّرَ الْأَصْنَامَ، وَأَظْهَرَ الْأَحْكَامَ، وَحَظَرَ الْحَرَامَ، وَعَمَّ بِالْإِنْعَامِ
verses.tr: Ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihil muṣṭafayna min aṭhari jibillatin, ṣalātan dāʾimatan ʿalal abadi ghayra muḍmaḥillatin, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan yatajaddadu bihā ḥubūruhu, wa yusharrafu bihā fil mīʿādi baʿthuhu wa nushūruhu, fa ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihil anjumiṭ ṭawāliʿi, ṣalātan tajūdu ʿalayhim ajwadal ghuyūthil hawāmiʿi, arsalahu min arjaḥil ʿarabi mīzānan, wa awḍaḥihā bayānan, wa afṣaḥihā lisānan, wa ashmakhihā īmānan, wa aʿlāhā maqāman, wa aḥlāhā kalāman, wa awfāhā dhimāman, wa aṣfāhā raghāman, fa awḍaḥaṭ ṭarīqata, wa naṣaḥal khalīqata, wa shahharal islāma, wa kassaral aṣnāma, wa aẓharal aḥkāma, wa ḥaẓaral ḥarāma, wa ʿamma bil inʿām
verses.en: May Allah bless him and his family, the Chosen Ones from the purest lineage, with blessings everlasting forever, never fading; may Allah bless him and his family with blessings by which his joy is ever renewed, and by which his resurrection and rising on the Promised Day are honored. So may Allah bless him and his family, the rising stars, with blessings more generous than the most abundant pouring rains. He sent him forth as the most just in measure of all the Arabs, the clearest in explanation, the most eloquent in speech, the loftiest in faith, the highest in station, the sweetest in word, the most faithful to his bond, and the purest in disposition. He made the Way clear, counseled creation, made Islam known, shattered the idols, made the ordinances plain, forbade the unlawful, and encompassed all with his favor.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ فِي كُلِّ مَحْفِلٍ وَمَقَامٍ، أَفْضَلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالسَّلَامِ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَوْدًا وَبَدْءًا، صَلَاةً تَكُونُ ذَخِيرَةً وَوِرْدًا ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً تَامَّةً زَاكِيَةً ۞ وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً يَتْبَعُهَا رَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ، وَيَعْقُبُهَا مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِضْوَانٌ
verses.tr: Ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi fī kulli maḥfilin wa maqāmin, afḍalaṣ ṣalāti was salāmi, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿawdan wa badʾan, ṣalātan takūnu dhakhīratan wa wirdan, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan tāmmatan zākiyyatan, wa ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan yatbaʿuhā rawḥun wa rayḥānun, wa yaʿqubuhā maghfiratun wa riḍwān
verses.en: May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, in every gathering and station, the finest of blessings and peace; may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, again and anew, blessings that are a treasure and a constant practice; may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, complete and pure blessings; and may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, blessings followed by comfort and fragrance, and succeeded by forgiveness and good pleasure.

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى أَفْضَلِ مَنْ طَابَ مِنْهُ النِّجَارُ، وَسَمَا بِهِ الْفَخَارُ، وَاسْتَنَارَتْ بِنُورِ جَبِينِهِ الْأَقْمَارُ، وَتَضَاءَلَتْ عِنْدَ جُودِ يَمِينِهِ الْغَمَائِمُ وَالْبِحَارُ ۞ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي بِبَاهِرِ آيَاتِهِ أَضَاءَتِ الْأَنْجَادُ وَالْأَغْوَارُ، ‖ وَبِمُعْجِزَاتِ آيَاتِهِ نَطَقَ الْكِتَابُ وَتَوَاتَرَتِ الْأَخْبَارُ
verses.tr: Wa ṣallallāhu ʿalā afḍali man ṭāba minhun nijāru, wa samā bihil fakhāru, wastanārat bi nūri jabīnihil aqmāru, wa taḍāʾalat ʿinda jūdi yamīnihil ghamāʾimu wal biḥāru, sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammadinil ladhī bi bāhiri āyātihi aḍāʾatil anjādu wal aghwāru, wa bi muʿjizāti āyātihi naṭaqal kitābu wa tawātaratil akhbār
verses.en: And may Allah's blessings be upon the finest of those from whom noble lineage sprang, through whom glory was exalted, by the light of whose brow the moons were illumined, before whose generous right hand the clouds and seas seemed small — our master and Prophet Muhammad, through whose dazzling signs the highlands and lowlands were lit, and through whose miraculous verses the Book spoke and reports were transmitted in succession.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا لِنُصْرَتِهِ، وَنَصَرُوهُ فِي هِجْرَتِهِ، فَنِعْمَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَنِعْمَ الْأَنْصَارُ ۞ صَلَاةً نَامِيَةً دَائِمَةً مَا سَجَعَتْ فِي أَيْكِهَا الْأَطْيَارُ، وَهَمَعَتْ بِوَبْلِهَا الدِّيمَةُ الْمِدْرَارُ، ضَاعَفَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ دَائِمَ صَلَوَاتِهِ
verses.tr: Ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihil ladhīna hājarū li nuṣratihi, wa naṣarūhu fī hijratihi, fa niʿmal muhājirūna wa niʿmal anṣāru, ṣalātan nāmiyatan dāʾimatan mā sajaʿat fī aykihal aṭyāru, wa hamaʿat bi wablihād dīmatul midrāru, ḍāʿafa Allāhu ʿalayhi dāʾima ṣalawātih
verses.en: May Allah's blessings be upon him, his family, and his Companions who emigrated to aid him and who aided him in his emigration — blessed indeed were the Emigrants, and blessed the Helpers — with blessings that grow and endure for as long as birds coo in their groves and steady, abundant rain pours down; may Allah multiply His everlasting blessings upon him.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الْكِرَامِ، صَلَاةً مَّوْصُولَةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ بِدَوَامِ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihiṭ ṭayyibīnal kirāmi, ṣalātan mawṣūlatan dāʾimatal ittiṣāli bi dawāmi dhil jalāli wal ikrām
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his good and noble family, with blessings joined and perpetually connected, abiding with the abiding of the Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ قُطْبُ الْجَلَالَةِ، وَشَمْسُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَالرِّسَالَةِ، وَالْهَادِي مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَالْمُنْقِذُ مِنَ الْجَهَالَةِ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ وَالتَّوَالِي، مُتَعَاقِبَةً بِتَعَاقُبِ الْأَيَّامِ وَاللَّيَالِي
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadinil ladhī huwa quṭbul jalālati, wa shamsun nubuwwati war risālati, wal hādī minaḍ ḍalālati, wal munqidhu minal jahālati, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama ṣalātan dāʾimatal ittiṣāli wat tawālī, mutaʿāqibatan bi taʿāqubil ayyāmi wal layālī
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, who is the Pole of Majesty, the Sun of Prophethood and the Message, the Guide away from error, and the Deliverer from ignorance; may Allah bless and grant him peace, with blessings perpetually joined and continuous, succeeding one another as the days and nights succeed one another.
